county_relationship.note: Counties come from each facility's resolved county. A ZIP can span several counties; the HUD USPS crosswalk (with weights) is not yet configured. Census ZCTAs approximate, but are not, USPS ZIP codes.

top_deficiency_types.title: Honor the resident's right to a dignified existence, self-determination, communication, and to exercise his or her rights.
Provide pharmaceutical services to meet the needs of each resident and employ or obtain the services of a licensed pharmacist.
Develop and implement a complete care plan that meets all the resident's needs, with timetables and actions that can be measured.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Inspect, test, and maintain automatic sprinkler systems.
Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.
Give residents notice of Medicaid/Medicare coverage and potential liability for services not covered.
Provide for the safe, appropriate administration of IV fluids for a resident when needed.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Protect each resident from the wrongful use of the resident's belongings or money.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies
